description: Spatial coverage is the proposed Sexsmith plant and its assessed setting. This Alberta environmental-assessment package describes a proposed Phase III formaldehyde production plant at Sexsmith in the County of Grande Prairie. Source metadata states production of up to 60000 tonnes, without specifying the time basis, and says the environmental impact assessment was deemed complete in 2008. It lists the main assessment PDF, a terrestrial-ecosystem and water-resource assessment PDF, and a ZIP of supplemental information. These documents form one source for the planned physical industrial facility and its environmental setting. The record does not establish that the plant was built or currently operates. A specific simulation model or numerical result is not identified by the inspected metadata. A specific simulation use is not assigned without further source evidence.
